name: com.seestocks/price-comparison
title: SeeStocks
description: Compare prices of products in Spanish online shops, with shipping costs, price history and deals.

tools.name: comparar_precios
tools.description: Use this when the user has already chosen a product (or a few) and wants to know where to buy it or to compare its price across shops: for example after you recommended a model. Pass each product as brand + model, the way it is sold (e.g. 'Cecotec Conga 3790', 'Bosch GSB 18V-55'), or its EAN/GTIN barcode if you know it (exact match); up to 5 products in one call. For each product, `coincidencia` is 'exacta' (SeeStocks has that product: `ofertas` lists every Spanish online shop that sells it, cheapest first, with price, shipping (`envio_eur` null = unknown, not free), total and link, plus the 90-day price `historial`), 'aproximada' (no exact match: `candidatos` may be other products, never present them as the requested one unless the name clearly matches) or 'no_encontrado' (say SeeStocks does not have it). Prices in euros.

productos.description: 1 to 5 products: brand + model, or EAN/GTIN.
productos.title: Productos

tools.name: buscar_productos
tools.description: Search products sold by Spanish online shops indexed by SeeStocks (es.seestocks.com) and get their current selling prices. Write `consulta` in Spanish, the way a shopper would (e.g. 'taladro percutor bateria', 'zapatillas running mujer 38'); an EAN barcode or a shop SKU also works. Use `marca` or `tienda` only when the user names a brand or a shop; a brand written inside the query is detected automatically. Results are sorted by relevance (best match first); to find the cheapest products of a type, use explorar_categoria instead, or pass `precio_max`. If the user has already chosen one specific product (brand + model or EAN), use comparar_precios instead. Prices are in euros as sold by the shop; `envio_eur` is the shipping cost (null means unknown, not free). Only relevant matches are returned: `total_relevantes` counts the matches among the best ~200 candidates, it is not the size of the catalogue. Each result has an `id`: use it with ficha_producto to get the price in every shop that sells it. `bajada_precio_anterior_eur` is a real price drop recorded by SeeStocks.

consulta.description: What the user is looking for, in Spanish.
consulta.title: Consulta

marca.description: Brand name or slug, only if the user names a brand.
marca.title: Marca

tienda.description: Shop id, only if the user names a shop.
tienda.title: Tienda

tools.name: ficha_producto
tools.description: Get every shop that sells a product, with price, shipping cost and total, sorted from cheapest. `id` comes from buscar_productos. Prices are in euros. `envio_eur` null means the shop does not publish the shipping cost (not free); `precio_total_eur` is then null too. `bajada` is a real price drop recorded by SeeStocks in the last 7 days. `pvp_tienda_eur` is the recommended retail price declared by the shop, not verified by SeeStocks: it is not a price drop. `historial` is the history of the lowest price across shops: 90-day minimum and maximum, whether today is the 90-day low, the last change and recent prices; `precio_estable_90d` true means the price has not changed for 90 days or more. Use it to say whether now is a good time to buy. `url` opens the shop's product page.

tools.name: ofertas_marca
tools.description: Get the recent price drops and discounted products of a brand, plus its price statistics. Use it when the user asks about deals, sales or prices of a brand in general (not of one product). `marca` is the brand name or slug (e.g. 'Bosch', 'bestway'). `bajadas` are real price drops recorded by SeeStocks in the last 30 days. `descuentos` are prices below the recommended retail price declared by the shop, which SeeStocks does not verify: present them as discounts on the declared price, not as price drops. Prices in euros.

tools.name: explorar_categoria
tools.description: Get an overview of a type of product in Spanish online shops: how many products and shops SeeStocks tracks, the price range (minimum, 10th percentile, median, 90th percentile, maximum), the cheapest products, the products sold by most shops and the biggest real price drops of the last 30 days. Use it for broad shopping questions ('robot aspirador barato', 'how much does an air fryer cost', 'which above-ground pools are on sale') rather than for one specific model. Pass `consulta` with the type of product in Spanish (e.g. 'freidora de aire', 'robot aspirador'); the category is detected with SeeStocks' search. If `categoria` is not what the user means, call again with `id_categoria` taken from `ruta` (broader) or `subcategorias` (narrower). Optional filters: price range in euros and brand. With `consulta`, the lists only hold products of the category that match the query (`listas_de` = 'consulta'); the price figures always cover the whole category. Lists leave out spare parts and accessories when `excluye_accesorios` is true. Each product has an `id` for ficha_producto. Prices are in euros; `envio_eur` null means unknown, not free.

consulta.description: Type of product in Spanish, e.g. 'freidora de aire'.
consulta.title: Consulta

id_categoria.description: Category id from a previous answer (ruta or subcategorias).
id_categoria.title: Id Categoria

marca.description: Brand name, only if the user names a brand.
marca.title: Marca
